text:
sam: quick note from today's midnight canary — we saw intermittent p95 jumps for a small cohort after host drains. looks correlated with sticky-session leases.
sam: symptoms: p95 ~2x for ~6% of requests, KV miss ratio spiked, retries climbed.
tara: timeline? was this during a scale-down or deployment?
sam: deployment + graceful-drain. new host had cold KV, sessions still routed by affinity -> heavy remote misses and occasional disk-backed reads.
nate: confirms from traces: proxy routed per affinity, model-server latency shows a 40-80ms variance consistent with KV page-in.
ivy: rough idea for fix? full rollback hurts product. can we do a controlled handoff instead?
sam: proposing "soft-handoff" flow: when we start draining, instead of immediate rebind, split incoming session traffic with a low probe fraction to the target. use probe responses to warm KV async. only increase split when probe success stable.
tara: what signals for "stable"? we need a compact decision surface for routing plane to evaluate.
nate: suggestion: p95_ratio (target/old), probe_failure_rate, and queue_util smoothed. keep it local per-cohort. central controller only for overrides.
sam: example config we could ship: {"mode":"soft-handoff","start_probe_pct":"2","max_probe_pct":"15","probe_window_s":"45","p95_ratio_threshold":"1.4","probe_success_min":"0.85"} — (we'll store as string values in config proto)
tara: note: start_probe_pct low to avoid extra load; ramp on success. also exponential backoff on failures.
ivy: session affinity policy? either continue serving existing affinity on old host until session end (sticky-hold) or attempt active prefix migration. active migration is heavier ops.
sam: recommend sticky-hold initially. less surface area. migration can be an opt-in path later.
nate: fallback trigger idea: if cohort aggregate p95 > 1.5x baseline for >3m OR probe_failures > 20% -> immediately shift weights back and mark fallback event. infra-bot: will emit rollout-stop events for fallback to central dashboard.
tara: need observability: Console should show probe_pct, probe_success, p95_ratio, current handoff state, last-fallback-reason per cohort.
ivy: add sampled flame traces and a short-lived KV-warmage histogram. retention short to control cost.
sam: implementation notes: 1) routing-plane state machine per variant-cohort, 2) probe handler that can send async prefetch to target modelhost (non-blocking), 3) local metrics and backoff logic, 4) simple central override API.
tara: testing: unit tests for state transitions, end-to-end canary with synthetic long-session traffic, chaos test injecting KV latency.
nate: I'll build a small simulator to sweep thresholds; want to see false-positive fallback rate.
sam: ops runbook: on fallback event, runbook should include quick-checks (recent drain events, KV miss rate, probe metrics), and steps: 1) pause rollout, 2) increase probe_pct for more warmup OR 3) rollback variant. ping eng-oncall for 24-48h after initial rollout.
ivy: we should also consider per-tenant knob — some tenants have longer sessions and higher prefix reuse. make cohorting flexible.
sam: agreed. will include per-tenant override in RFC.
infra-bot: scheduled-canary: job 2024-04-10T00:00Z scheduled for variant v5. notify eng-infra on handoff/fallback events.
tara: I'll add dashboard panels and an alert: probe_failure_rate > 0.2 over 5m for any cohort.
nate: will send initial simulator results tomorrow. sam: i'll draft the RFC and runbook today and link testing plans. thanks all :thumbsup:
